errors.error_description: Introduced an unreachable FSM state S_UNUSED in the enum that is never transitioned into.
Used logical AND (&&) between 4-bit vectors to form grant_mask, causing boolean reduction and width coercion instead of bitwise masking.
Created an excessively deep nested if-else decision chain in the combinational path to compute compute_next, harming synthesis quality and timing.
Mixed blocking (=) with non-blocking (<=) assignments in the same always_ff sequential block by updating byte_count with a blocking assignment.
